canonicalIngredients.name: tomato passata/sauce
observations: 1/2 cup canned tomato sauce, replaces water (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: taco seasoning
observations: 3 tbsp homemade or store-bought per 1 lb (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: taco shells
observations: 8 white corn tortillas, fried into shells (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: sour cream
observations: 125 g sriracha mayo and/or sour cream (s0)

causalSequence: mix spice blend (or measure packet taco seasoning)
brown mince, break up lumps; soften onion, garlic (before or alongside)
stir in seasoning + tomato paste, toast 1 min
add water (or tomato sauce, or beans + water); simmer 3-5 min until thick but still saucy
techniqueFacts: all three season browned mince with a taco spice blend then simmer briefly (3-5 min) to a thick, still-moist coat
s1 and s2 drain fat after browning; s1 keeps ~1 tbsp in the pan for flavour
liquid diverges: s0/s1 add ~125 ml water (s1 allows broth); s2 skips water and uses 1/2 cup tomato sauce so spices cling
spice route diverges: s1 uses 3 tbsp pre-mixed taco seasoning per 1 lb; s0/s2 itemise components (cumin + oregano + onion/garlic powder, plus paprika s0 / chili powder s2)
s0 stretches 300 g mince with a 400 g can of kidney beans to feed 4
s0 blooms fresh onion and garlic in oil before the mince; s1 browns mince first then softens onion in the fat; s2 uses no fresh aromatics, only granulated
shells: s2 shallow-fries 6-inch corn tortillas ~30 sec/side and folds while hot; s1 crisps bought shells at 325 F 4-6 min or warms tortillas 30 sec/side in a dry pan
toppings are build-your-own in all three; cheese, lettuce/cabbage, tomato, avocado, sour cream recur
s1 counts servings as 8 tacos; s2 FAQ holds 1 lb mince feeds 4 at 2-3 tbsp per taco
regular (not lean) mince preferred in all three for flavour and moisture
make-ahead: filling keeps 2-4 days refrigerated, 2-3 months frozen (all three)
